transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, July 29. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Centre may table bill to make deepfakes, digital arrest separate offences. The government plans to introduce a bill addressing digital arrests and AI deepfakes. Existing laws do not define these emerging digital crimes effectively. The Supreme Court urged the government to create specific offenses for these issues. This new legislation will categorize digital arrest and deepfakes as distinct offenses. NEET protest: All SOPs followed, pellet gun use on protesters authorised - CRPF review. CRPF analysis indicates police action against protesters followed standard operating procedures. Non-lethal means like pellet guns were authorized for crowd dispersal. Force gradient was followed, with lower measures failing before pump action guns. Protesters and personnel sustained injuries during the July 20 incident. CWG 2026: Gulveer Singh creates history, becomes first Indian to win Men's 10,000m medal. Gulveer Singh secured a historic silver medal in the men's 10,000m race. He became the first Indian to achieve this feat at the Commonwealth Games. Singh finished second behind Australia's Ky Robinson in Glasgow. The national record holder clocked a time of 27:49.78 during the event. After stalemate, government, opposition spar over paper leak law in Lok Sabha. Parliament debated a bill to strengthen penalties for exam paper leaks. Opposition members supported student protests and criticized police actions during demonstrations. Government speakers highlighted past paper leaks and PM Modi's reform efforts. They emphasized the bill's aim to protect student welfare and ensure fair examinations. What made California's largest AI datacenter file a lawsuit over access to river water. California's largest AI data centre seeks Colorado River water after wastewater plans failed. The company needs 287 million gallons annually for its proposed facility. Local cities and the Imperial Irrigation District rejected its initial water requests. This move raises concerns about the impact on regional farming and jobs. Trump, Netanyahu hold 'excellent' White House meeting as Iran differences come into focus. US President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu met at the White House to discuss Iran. Both leaders sought to manage differences over the future course of the conflict. They also discussed implementing a US Reports on alleged cybersecurity incident involving DRDO are incorrect: Sources. Official sources have denied reports of a cybersecurity incident involving DRDO data. Investigations found no evidence of active cyber attacks or unauthorized network intrusions. Most alleged leaked data is unclassified and from an old breach. Threat actors fabricated documents to appear recent and confidential for financial gain. Ahmedabad tragedy: SC accepts pilot dad's plea not to make Air India crash report public. The Supreme Court accepted a father's request concerning the air crash inquiry report. The government will submit the final report in a sealed cover to the court. An NGO questioned the inquiry's impartiality and adherence to standard procedures. The Air Accident Investigation Bureau anticipates completing its investigation within six weeks. US man arrested for wiping phone during airport search; Android OS may trouble Europe travellers. A federal case in Atlanta questions privacy software use as criminal intent evidence. Prosecutors accuse Samuel Tunick of wiping his phone to prevent authorities from accessing its contents. GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. Don't touch water bodies under garb of beautification, Supreme Court tells Bihar govt. The Supreme Court has ordered the Bihar government to stop filling historic ponds in Darbhanga. This action follows allegations that the state is filling water bodies for public amenities. The court warned the state not to touch the ponds without its explicit approval. The project aimed to beautify and rejuvenate Gangasagar, Digghi, and Harahi Lake. Teen's nuclear energy idea could cut Antarctic base emissions by 3,254 tons. A young Chilean student has proposed an innovative energy system for Antarctica. This concept combines renewable sources with a nuclear microreactor for reliable power. The system aims to significantly reduce diesel fuel dependence and carbon emissions. It offers a potential solution for powering remote research stations in extreme conditions.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Guru Purnima Special: Bhopal Artists Keep Guru-Shishya Legacy Alive At Home. As Guru Purnima is celebrated on Wednesday, four young artists from Bhopal are keeping the timeless Guru-Shishya Parampara alive by learning their craft from family members. MANIT Team Begins Scientific Revival of Burhanpur's 400-Year-Old Kundi Bhandara. A MANIT Bhopal team, along with water management experts, has begun the scientific conservation of Burhanpur's 400-year-old Kundi Bhandara underground water system. Farmers' March Chokes Bhopal: 11-Mill Barricading Triggers Hours-Long Traffic Jam. Heavy barricading at 11-Mill Tiraha for a farmers' march caused hours-long traffic congestion on Hoshangabad Road (NH-46) in Bhopal on Tuesday. MP's Rising Tiger Population Brings New Conservation, Human Conflict Challenges. Madhya Pradesh's rising tiger population is creating fresh conservation challenges as big cats increasingly move beyond protected areas into villages in search of territory. Demand for MSP, reforms: Protesting farmers breach police barricades enroute to Bhopal. Property Dispute Murder: Father-Son Duo Gets Life Term After 12 Years. A district court sentenced Pradeep Rathore and his father Omprakash Rathore to life imprisonment in a 12-year-old murder case linked to a property dispute. 2,000 farmers march towards Bhopal, bedding and cooking material in hand. Indore Elephant Attack: Collector Orders Action Against Those Responsible For Bringing Jumbo. Two days after an autorickshaw driver was killed in an elephant attack in Rajnagar, Indore Collector Shivam Verma directed the Forest Department to take action against those responsible for bringing the elephant into an urban area. Farmers from central MP districts march to Bhopal demanding 100 percent procurement of Moong crop on MSP. MP: Farmers march from Narmadapuram to Bhopal demanding moong procurement at MSP, related issues. Indore Cleanliness Model Draws Australia's Attention, Delegation Studies Waste System. A high-level Australian delegation led by MP Roy Butler visited Indore on Tuesday to study its acclaimed waste management system. Thousands of farmers march into Bhopal, vow to continue protest until demands are met. Mild monsoon, roads look flood‐battered: Bhopal streets riddled with potholes, cause jams. Madhya Pradesh CM highlights rail expansion for Simhastha 2028. Madhya Pradesh CM gives instructions for food arrangements on Kanwar Yatra routes. Metro Ridership Surges as AIIMS, Board Office Stations Draw More Passengers. Make model guidelines for elephant upkeep in 4 weeks: MP HC. 13 injured as jackal attacks residents in Itarsi.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Oil Holds Three-Day Drop as Tensions in the Middle East Cool. Oil held the bulk of a three-day decline on optimism that the US and Iran may be able to forge a diplomatic solution to end the war in the Middle East, with the conflict now in its sixth month. Nasdaq 100 Is Approaching a Correction as Chips Selloff Worsens. The Nasdaq 100 Index inched closer to a correction Tuesday as the selloff in semiconductor stocks turns ugly with investors questioning the amount of money Big Tech is spending on artificial intelligence. Yen's Relentless Slide to Test Ueda's Capacity to Calm Traders. A key risk moment looms for the yen for this week when Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda speaks after the central bank's policy meeting on Friday. Goldman Says Japan's AI Stock Trade 'Not Broken' After Rout. Goldman Sachs Japan Co. says a sharp selloff in Japan's artificial intelligence-related stocks has created a buying opportunity, arguing that strong earnings could revive investor appetite for semiconductor shares. Chip Rout Sinks Emerging-Market Stocks; Currencies Trade Mixed. A selloff in semiconductor stocks pressured Asian bourses and pushed the emerging-market benchmark to the lowest in more than three months, while currencies were mixed on the eve of the Federal Reserve's decision. TSX hits record high, led by tech and financial shares. CANADA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 2):CANADA STOCKS-TSX hits record high, led by tech and financial shares Citadel Securities' Fed Rate Hike Call Adds to Market Angst. On the eve of the Federal Reserve's policy decision, bond traders are on edge. While most expect policymakers to leave interest rates unchanged, prominent voices across Wall Street are putting their weight behind a hike in just the second meeting run by new Chairman Kevin Warsh. Treasury yields retreat as oil tumbles before Fed policy decision. USA-BONDS/ (UPDATE 1, GRAPHICS):TREASURIES Adani to set up 2,000-bed hospital in Bengal. West Bengal is enhancing its healthcare infrastructure statewide and in the private sector. Crude prices extend decline, fall over 5 percent on US-Iran talks optimism; Brent down 20 percent in three sessions. Crude oil prices fell over 5 percent on Tuesday, driven by hopes of a US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough, easing supply disruption fears. Brent crude dropped to $80.67 and WTI to $77.83, continuing a downward trend after recent military de-escalation and renewed diplomatic efforts in the region. Air India may be confronting a rupees 1,200 cr loss. Singapore Airlines reported a net loss of rupees 311.78 crore from its Air India stake. Pentagon blacklist of CXMT: Is Washington accidentally creating a stronger Chinese chip rival?. CXMT's shares soared 466 percent on its Shanghai Stock Exchange debut, elevating its market value to 3.28 trillion yuan. Amid US sanctions, CXMT faces challenges but also an incentive to strengthen its domestic chip production capabilities, impacting the global DRAM market. The making of Sharmila Dhankar's CWG gold. Sharmila Dhankar overcame domestic abuse and polio to win a gold medal. Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver slide as stronger dollar, Fed uncertainty weigh. Gold and silver prices faced selling pressure as investors awaited the US Federal Reserve's policy meeting. A stronger US dollar and rising interest rate expectations impacted precious metals, while geopolitical tensions eased, creating a complex market environment for investors. Canara Bank plans rupees 8,000 cr capital raise. Canara Bank will frontload expected credit loss provisioning within two years. Coal India Q1 capex rises 16.6 percent YoY to rupees 3,399 crore, beats quarterly target. Coal India's June quarter capex reached rupees 3,399 crore, marking a 16.6 percent YoY rise and surpassing targets. Investments in land acquisition and renewable energy were notable, alongside a slight increase in consolidated profit, despite a considerable rise in operating expenses. Tata preps F and B push for post-weight-loss needs. Tata Consumer Products is developing new foods and beverages. Rail Vikas Nigam shares to be in focus on Wednesday as company secures a rupees 356 crore order. Rail Vikas Nigam has received a Letter of Acceptance for a rupees 358.97 crore EPC contract from East Central Railway. The project includes doubling railway works and is set for completion within 730 days, following recent contract wins totaling over rupees 3,500 crore. Brookfield-Oaktree deal, digit merger get CCI nod. The Competition Commission of India approved two significant corporate proposals on Tuesday. Birlasoft Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 51 percent YoY to rupees 161 crore; TCV rises 20 percent. Birlasoft reported Q1 FY27 revenue of rupees 1,379.4 crore, up 2.3 percent sequentially. Net profit rose 51.3 percent YoY to rupees 161 crore. The company signed $169 million worth of deals, a 20 percent increase from last year, while voluntary attrition declined to 11.7 percent . PoK violence: 20 dead in clashes over rigged polls. Violence has escalated in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir with clashes reported between protesters and authorities. Expert view: 10 sectors that could generate alpha over the next 5–10 years, according to Right Horizons PMS founder. Discover insights from Anil Rego, founder of Right Horizons PMS, as he reveals 10 high-potential sectors that could thrive despite market uncertainties. Rego sees Nifty earnings growth of around 12 percent CAGR during FY26-FY28E. TDP and Sena seek multiple NEET attempts a year. Key NDA allies proposed conducting the NEET-UG exam multiple times annually. US stock market today: Wall Street edges lower as chip stocks face fresh sell-off; Brent slips below $85. US stock futures are set for a weaker open as global semiconductor stocks drop amid concerns about AI spending returns. Nasdaq-100 futures fell 0.9 percent , with Micron Technology declining 4.5 percent . Will continue to invest in India: Unilever CEO. The dove soap maker expects its India arm, Hindustan Unilever, to deliver a high-single digit growth in the coming quarters, with profit growth slightly outpacing revenue growth, according to chief financial officer Srinivas Phatak. Mint Explainer Why Sebi is overhauling online dispute resolution. Sebi has proposed a sweeping overhaul of its online dispute resolution framework, shifting administration to market infrastructure institutions to speed up investor grievance redressal, strengthen enforcement and improve accountability. Shoshone restore site of 1863's deadly US massacre. In 1863, the Bear River Massacre became the deadliest slaughter of Native Americans in US history, leaving hundreds of Shoshone men, women and children dead in a winter attack.

transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Can you change the income tax regime while filing ITR? Here's what taxpayers should know. However, rules differ for those with business income. Understanding the flexibility and tax impact can help taxpayers make an informed choice. The government has revealed that the EPFO has developed an Aadhaar-based e-portal to help members trace old inoperative PF accounts, transfer balances to their active UAN or settle claims. The portal aims to reduce paperwork, improve transparency and simplify access to forgotten PF savings. The Modified Assured Career Progression scheme began on September 1, 2008. This means the scheme was not active during their service period. Employee bodies are now demanding more MACP promotions for Group C and B staff. Delhi HC orders Paytm Payments Bank to be wound up: What happens to your Paytm wallet, UPI now?. The Delhi High Court ordered the winding up of Paytm Payments Bank Ltd due to non-compliance with regulations. EPS pension: These pensioners will automatically get their pension benefits under EPS 2026, minister clarifies in Parliament. The government has notified the EPS pension 2026 scheme, superseding older plans. Existing pension fund benefits are protected under the new scheme. A special drive is underway to dispose of pending labor cases expeditiously. The new scheme maintains the pension calculation formula and contribution rates. New versus old regime: Income tax slab rates for FY26 , know how slab-wise tax calculation works. Taxpayers should compare the new and old tax regimes before filing their ITR for FY26. Since India follows a slab-based tax system, only the portion of income falling within each tax slab is taxed at the applicable rate. Understanding this helps taxpayers estimate tax liability more accurately. ITR filing deadline: With July 31 due date near, how to check Annual Information Statement (AIS) through password. Before filing your Income Tax Return (ITR), it is important to check your Annual Information Statement (AIS). No Form 16 yet? 31 July ITR deadline is near, here's how salaried taxpayers can still file their income tax return. Form 16 makes return filing easier, but it is not the only document required. By reconciling salary records with Form 26AS, AIS, bank statements and investment proofs, salaried taxpayers can accurately file their returns even without Form 16.
